title: A Russian Plot to Kill U.S. Soldiers

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上对精选采访进行现场直播，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订户，您可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得一个月免费访问我们所有新闻报道的权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天是。

sentences.en: A Times investigation has revealed evidence of a secret Russian operation to kill American soldiers in Afghanistan
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的一项调查揭露了一项秘密俄罗斯行动的证据，该行动旨在杀害阿富汗的美军士兵

sentences.en: and the failure of the Trump administration to act on that evidence.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普政府未能对这些证据采取行动。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague, Eric Schmidt, one of the reporters who broke the original story about what we know now.
sentences.zh: 我采访了我的同事埃里克·施密特，他是率先报道我们目前所知内幕的记者之一。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, July 1St.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月1日，星期三。

sentences.en: Eric, how is it that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 埃里克，美军是如何

sentences.en: first learned that Russia was up to something in Afghanistan?
sentences.zh: 最初得知俄罗斯在阿富汗有小动作的？

sentences.en: So, Michael, about six months ago or so, U.S.
sentences.zh: 是这样的，迈克尔，大约半年前，

sentences.en: commandos working with Afghan allies carried out a raid on a Taliban safe house.
sentences.zh: 与阿富汗盟友合作的美军突击队对塔利班的一个安全屋发动了突袭。

sentences.en: And they made a remarkable discovery.
sentences.zh: 他们有一个惊人的发现。

sentences.en: They found some $500,000 in American money inside this safe house.
sentences.zh: 他们在这个安全屋里发现了大约 50 万美元的美国现金。

sentences.en: Now, to be sure, from time to time, when they do these kind of raids, you find weapons and you find other kinds of things, even some money.
sentences.zh: 当然，平心而论，他们有时在进行这类突袭时，会发现武器和其他东西，甚至还有一些钱。

sentences.en: But the military sources that we've talked to said they'd never seen such a large haul.
sentences.zh: 但我们交谈过的军方消息人士表示，他们从未见过如此巨额的缴获。

sentences.en: I mean, what would these guys be doing with $500,000?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些人拿着 50 万美元想干什么？

sentences.en: How did they get it?
sentences.zh: 他们是怎么弄到这笔钱的？

sentences.en: And what was it going to be used for?
sentences.zh: 这笔钱将用于何处？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, this set off a lot of questions.
sentences.zh: 所以，这引发了许多疑问。

sentences.en: And as they conduct other raids, the commandos, CIA, other authorities in Afghanistan, they seize the cell phones of different fighters, Taliban fighters.
sentences.zh: 随着他们进行其他突袭，突击队员、中情局和阿富汗的其他当局缴获了不同武装人员（塔利班武装人员）的手机。

sentences.en: And they start exploiting that to see if there's any clues in the cell phones that might lead them back to the source of this money.
sentences.zh: 他们开始利用这些手机，看看里面是否有任何线索能顺藤摸瓜找到这笔钱的来源。

sentences.en: But perhaps one of the most important things that happens is when they seize a couple of very important senior Taliban and Taliban-related figures.
sentences.zh: 但也许最重要的事情之一是，他们抓获了几个非常重要的资深塔利班及塔利班相关人物。

sentences.en: And, of course, that's one of the first things they want to ask these operatives is, do you know anything about this money?
sentences.zh: 当然，他们最想问这些特工的第一件事就是：你们知道这笔钱的事吗？

sentences.en: And what do the Miltons say?
sentences.zh: 米尔顿他们是怎么说的？

sentences.en: They had a remarkable story to tell, that this was money that they had been paid,
sentences.zh: 他们讲了一个惊人的故事，说这是一笔他们收到的钱，

sentences.en: that they'd been paid by a secretive Russian military intelligence unit for the express purpose of killing American, British, and other coalition forces in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 是阿富汗的一个神秘俄罗斯军事情报单位付给他们的，其明确目的就是杀害美国、英国和其他联军部队。

sentences.en: But these investigators, they were searching around for other proof, how to link all this together.
sentences.zh: 但这些调查人员正在四处寻找其他证据，以了解如何将这一切串联起来。

sentences.en: Because, of course, how do you assess that these Taliban guys weren't telling lies or some kind of disinformation?
sentences.zh: 因为，当然，你如何评估这些塔利班家伙没有撒谎或散布某种虚假信息呢？

sentences.en: And then investigators learned of something else that sealed the deal, that seemed to kind of be the glue that pieced all these disparate parts together.
sentences.zh: 接着，调查人员获悉了另一件敲定此事的事情，这似乎成了将所有这些零散部分拼凑在一起的粘合剂。

sentences.en: And that was intercepts, basically electronic intercepts of the financial transactions themselves, from this Russian military intelligence unit, down to the Afghans on the ground,
sentences.zh: 那就是截获的情报，基本上是该俄罗斯军事情报单位与地面阿富汗人之间金融交易的电子拦截，

sentences.en: who were the intermediaries, who were basically managing this program for them there.
sentences.zh: 这些阿富汗人是中间人，基本上负责在那里为他们管理这个项目。

sentences.en: And then on to the killers themselves, before they were dispatched to target the American forces there.
sentences.zh: 然后直到杀手本人，在他们被派遣去目标地对付美军之前。

sentences.en: Essentially, it was electronic paper trail, receipts, if you will, for services asked and services rendered.
sentences.zh: 本质上，这是一条电子纸质线索，如果你愿意的话，这就是索取服务和提供服务的收据。

sentences.en: This became a very compelling argument that the military, CIA, and other authorities in Afghanistan started putting together.
sentences.zh: 这成了军方、中情局和阿富汗其他当局开始拼凑的一个非常令人信服的论点。

sentences.en: And a very serious conclusion, because from what you're describing, U.S.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常严重的结论，因为从你所描述的情况来看，美国

sentences.en: intelligence officials are not just putting together a theory that this money was offered to Taliban fighters to go after Americans, to basically kill them for hire,
sentences.zh: 情报官员不仅仅是在拼凑一种理论，即这笔钱被提供给塔利班战士去追捕美国人，基本上是雇凶杀人，

sentences.en: but that money had actually been paid out to them, suggesting that such killings had occurred.
sentences.zh: 而且这笔钱实际上已经支付给了他们，这表明此类谋杀确实发生过。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: This wasn't just in theory, but there was the idea that they'd actually recovered some of the proceeds that the Russians had paid the Afghans to carry out this mission.
sentences.zh: 这不仅停留在理论上，而且有迹象表明，他们实际上追回了俄罗斯人支付给阿富汗人执行这项任务的部分收益。

sentences.en: So obviously, the next task was to figure out what deaths may have been actually the result of this campaign.
sentences.zh: 因此很明显，接下来的任务是弄清楚实际上有哪些死亡可能是这场运动的结果。

sentences.en: And do we have an answer?
sentences.zh: 我们有答案吗？

sentences.en: So the military and the intelligence officers, working with Afghan officials, started looking back over different attacks to see which looked suspicious.
sentences.zh: 于是，军方和情报官员与阿富汗官员合作，开始回顾不同的袭击事件，以找出看起来可疑的事件。

sentences.en: And their attentions focused on one in particular, three Marines who were killed on a patrol just outside of Bagram Air Base.
sentences.zh: 他们的注意力集中在其中一个事件上，三名海军陆战队员在巴格拉姆空军基地外的一场巡逻中丧生。

sentences.en: They were patrolling on a normal day when a large car bomb basically blew up.
sentences.zh: 他们在一个平常的日子里巡逻，当时一辆大型汽车炸弹基本上爆炸了。

sentences.en: And this is something that the military is still determining, just what the links were, if any, to this program of this attack.
sentences.zh: 军方仍在确定这起袭击与该计划之间的联系（如果有的话）。

sentences.en: But it was suspicious.
sentences.zh: 但这确实很可疑。

sentences.en: And it may have had the hallmarks of this program and some of the receipts tying back to it.
sentences.zh: 它可能带有该计划的特征，并且有一些收据可以追溯到它。

sentences.en: And Eric, in the minds of these intelligence officials who are starting to piece this Russian bounty system together, why would Russia do this?
sentences.zh: 埃里克，在开始将这个俄罗斯赏金系统拼凑在一起的这些情报官员看来，俄罗斯为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: I mean, why would they pay the Taliban to kill U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们为什么要花钱让塔利班杀死美国

sentences.en: soldiers?
sentences.zh: 士兵？

sentences.en: Well, Michael, I think you have to go back in the history of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克尔，我认为你必须回溯美国

sentences.en: and Russia and Afghanistan, essentially to the very end of the Cold War, where in the late 1980s, the CIA secretly armed the Mujahideen resistance against the Soviet Union,
sentences.zh: 、俄罗斯和阿富汗的历史，本质上要追溯到冷战的末期，在20世纪80年代末，中情局秘密武装了反对苏联的圣战者抵抗力量，

sentences.en: which had invaded and occupied Afghanistan for nearly a decade.
sentences.zh: 苏联入侵并占领了阿富汗近十年。

sentences.en: And the United States helped accelerate the departure of Soviet soldiers from Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 美国帮助加速了苏联士兵撤出阿富汗。

sentences.en: Fast forward to after 9-11, when it's the U.S.
sentences.zh: 快进到9·11事件之后，正是美国

sentences.en: that invades Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 入侵了阿富汗。

sentences.en: Russians want a stable government there.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯人希望那里有一个稳定的政府。

sentences.en: They don't like the al-Qaeda any more than the United States does.
sentences.zh: 他们和美国一样痛恨基地组织。

sentences.en: And so for some years, there's actually some cooperation between Moscow and Washington until a few years ago,
sentences.zh: 因此多年来，莫斯科和华盛顿之间实际上进行了一些合作，直到几年前，

sentences.en: when President Putin of Russia starts to become disillusioned with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当俄罗斯总统普京开始对美国的

sentences.en: plan in Afghanistan, doesn't believe it's going to work.
sentences.zh: 阿富汗计划感到幻灭，不相信它会成功时。

sentences.en: And begins behind the backs of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 并开始在美军背后

sentences.en: to support the Taliban, provide weapons, arms to the Taliban, who are still fighting the United States.
sentences.zh: 支持塔利班，向仍在与美国战斗的塔利班提供武器。

sentences.en: And so we start to see this break where Russia is basically looking for ways to inflict pain on the United States and maybe even accelerate the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们开始看到这种决裂，俄罗斯基本上在寻找方法来给美国造成痛苦，甚至可能加速美军

sentences.en: departure from Afghanistan, just as decades before the U.S.
sentences.zh: 撤出阿富汗，就像几十年前美国

sentences.en: had done to the Soviet Union.
sentences.zh: 对苏联所做的那样。

sentences.en: So if you put that framework where Russia is now looking for a way to replace the United States as the power inside of Afghanistan and humiliate the United States at the same time,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果把这个框架放在这里：俄罗斯现在正在寻找一种方法来取代美国成为阿富汗内部的强权，并同时羞辱美国，

sentences.en: this bounty program starts to make a little bit of sense.
sentences.zh: 这个赏金计划就开始变得有点道理了。

sentences.en: If this secretive military intelligence unit can put bounties on the heads of American soldiers and increase the number of casualties,
sentences.zh: 如果这个秘密军事情报单位可以在美军士兵的脑袋上悬赏赏金并增加伤亡人数，

sentences.en: presumably that would also stir unrest back in the United States, already war-weary after two decades of conflict in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 据推测，这也将在美国国内重新激起不安，毕竟美国在阿富汗经历了二十年的冲突后已经对战争感到厌倦。

sentences.en: So the Russian theory is, why not just speed that departure along?
sentences.zh: 所以俄罗斯的逻辑是，为什么不干脆加速撤离呢？

sentences.en: We take the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们取代美国

sentences.en: place and we humiliate Washington and President Trump in the process.
sentences.zh: 的地位，在这个过程中羞辱华盛顿和特朗普总统。

sentences.en: And I guess the reason why Russia would turn to a middleman, the Taliban, on this is because it would never want to attack U.S.
sentences.zh: 我想俄罗斯之所以在这件事上求助于中间人塔利班，是因为它绝不想在阿富汗独自攻击美国

sentences.en: soldiers on its own in Afghanistan, just the way the U.S.
sentences.zh: 士兵，就像美国

sentences.en: didn't want to ever attack Russian soldiers directly in the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪80年代从不想直接攻击俄罗斯士兵一样。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You hire basically cutouts to do your dirty work, and it's very hard for the other side to prove that you're responsible.
sentences.zh: 你基本上是雇佣代理人来干脏活，对方很难证明你是负责人。

sentences.en: When it's murky like this, and you have Afghan intermediaries, criminals on the ground, and monies passing back and forth, Russians would have plausible deniability to say, oh,
sentences.zh: 当情况如此扑朔迷离，有阿富汗中间人、地面的犯罪分子以及资金来回流动时，俄罗斯人就可以进行合理否认，说，哦，

sentences.en: perhaps we were just supporting them for other aiMs.
sentences.zh: 也许我们只是出于其他目的支持他们。

sentences.en: There's no evidence that we were behind this.
sentences.zh: 没有证据表明是我们幕后主使。

sentences.en: But, Eric, even so, even with a middleman cutout, as you just called it,
sentences.zh: 但是，埃里克，即便如此，即使有你刚才所说的中间代理人，

sentences.en: I have to imagine that this kind of an operation by Russia is very risky and represents a pretty significant escalation by Russia.
sentences.zh: 我也可以想象，俄罗斯的这种行动风险很高，代表着俄罗斯相当显著的升级。

sentences.en: Absolutely, Michael.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Any time you have a foreign power, much less one like Russia, targeting American service members, American troops on the ground, that is a very serious thing.
sentences.zh: 任何时候，当一个外国强权，更不用说像俄罗斯这样的国家，将美军成员、地面美军作为目标时，那都是一件非常严重的事情。

sentences.en: Right, because this is in its own way almost a kind of act of war.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为这在某种程度上几乎是一种战争行为。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对的。

sentences.en: That's the way many people would see it.
sentences.zh: 许多人都会这样看。

sentences.en: Just because Russia might be using intermediaries or henchmen to do this, they're the ones responsible.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为俄罗斯可能是在利用中间人或爪牙来做这件事，他们也是责任人。

sentences.en: They're the ones setting these killings in motion if they've happened.
sentences.zh: 如果这些谋杀已经发生，他们就是幕后推手。

sentences.en: They're the ones that are essentially bribing the killers to carry out the attacks.
sentences.zh: 他们本质上是在贿赂杀手去执行袭击。

sentences.en: And that's something that's very, very serious.
sentences.zh: 这是一件非常非常严重的事情。

sentences.en: And the Pentagon and the White House would have to address it.
sentences.zh: 五角大楼和白宫将不得不对此作出回应。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用程序，并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So Eric, in your reporting on this Russian bounty operation, what do you learn about how the White House,
sentences.zh: 那么埃里克，在你对这次俄罗斯赏金行动的报道中，你了解到白宫是如何

sentences.en: how the Pentagon decides to respond to the conclusion of the intelligence agencies that this operation exists?
sentences.zh: 五角大楼是如何决定对情报机构关于该行动存在的结论作出回应的？

sentences.en: So this assessment that's been put together by the CIA and the military special operations forces in Afghanistan starts to make its way up the chain of command into Washington sometime in late January,
sentences.zh: 因此，由中情局和阿富汗军事特种作战部队共同做出的这份评估，在1月下旬的某个时候开始沿着指挥链向上呈报到华盛顿，

sentences.en: early February, perhaps.
sentences.zh: 也许是2月初。

sentences.en: And it's very closely held.
sentences.zh: 而且它被保密得极好。

sentences.en: It's one of the top intelligence and news items that's put together every day for the president to read.
sentences.zh: 这是每天为总统阅读而整理的最高级别的情报和新闻项目之一。

sentences.en: President Trump is not known to read it very often, very much.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，特朗普总统并不经常阅读它。

sentences.en: He relies more on verbal briefings, oral briefings.
sentences.zh: 他更多地依赖口头简报。

sentences.en: But by February 27th, our sources tell us it was in that document.
sentences.zh: 但我们的消息来源告诉我们，到2月27日，它已经在那份文件中了。

sentences.en: About a month later, at the end of March, the National Security Council, the National Security Army of the White House,
sentences.zh: 大约一个月后，即3月底，白宫国家安全委员会，白宫的国家安全智囊机构，

sentences.en: holds its first meeting to discuss the intelligence assessment.
sentences.zh: 召开了第一次会议，讨论这项情报评估。

sentences.en: It's representatives from the State Department, from the Pentagon, from the CIA, from around the government who can weigh in about the impact this might have.
sentences.zh: 与会代表来自国务院、五角大楼、中情局以及政府各部门，他们可以就此可能产生的影响发表意见。

sentences.en: And most important, the options.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，还有各种选项。

sentences.en: How should the United States government respond to this?
sentences.zh: 美国政府应该如何应对？

sentences.en: And the options that are discussed at this meeting in late March include everything from sending Moscow a stern letter, basically cease and desist or else,
sentences.zh: 3月下旬这次会议上讨论的选项包括：从向莫斯科发出严厉信函（基本上是勒令其停止，否则后果自负），

sentences.en: all the way up to sanctions, economic sanctions on top of those already imposed on Moscow that have been proven effective and damaging their economy.
sentences.zh: 一直到实施经济制裁——在已经对莫斯科实施并已被证明有效且损害其经济的制裁之上再加码。

sentences.en: We don't know if President Trump was briefed on any of these options, but we do know that his administration did not authorize any kind of action in response.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道特朗普总统是否被简报过这些选项，但我们确实知道他的政府没有授权采取任何应对行动。

sentences.en: Nothing has happened so far as a result of this assessment.
sentences.zh: 根据这项评估，到目前为止还没有发生任何事情。

sentences.en: So that's the way things stood for many weeks, that this was very tightly held information at the most senior levels of the government until late last week.
sentences.zh: 事情就这样持续了好几个星期，直到上周晚些时候，这依然是政府最高层严加保守的信息。

sentences.en: This is sort of stunning.
sentences.zh: 这有点令人震惊。

sentences.en: Here's the lead.
sentences.zh: 这就是导语。

sentences.en: When the Times published a major investigation, it basically spelled out everything we've just been discussing.
sentences.zh: 当《时报》发表了一项重大调查时，它基本上阐述了我们刚才一直在讨论的一切。

sentences.en: A New York Times report alleges Russia offered bounties to the Taliban in exchange for killing U.S.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的一篇报道称，俄罗斯向塔利班提供赏金，以换取杀死美国

sentences.en: forces in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 驻阿富汗部队。

sentences.en: And what was the immediate reaction to all that information?
sentences.zh: 对所有这些信息的直接反应是什么？

sentences.en: Look, I'm sick to my stomach over this.
sentences.zh: 听着，我对这件事感到恶心透顶。

sentences.en: Well, the immediate reaction was one of stunned disbelief.
sentences.zh: 嗯，最初的反应是震惊和难以置信。

sentences.en: Sick to my stomach as a member of Congress, a patriot, but also as someone who served in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 作为一名国会议员、一个爱国者，同时也是一个在阿富汗服役过的人，我感到恶心极了。

sentences.en: This is as bad as it gets.
sentences.zh: 这真是糟透了。

sentences.en: Both by Democrats and Republicans in Congress.
sentences.zh: 国会的民主党人和共和党人都是如此。

sentences.en: And yet the president will not confront the Russians on this score.
sentences.zh: 然而总统却不愿在这方面与俄罗斯人对质。

sentences.en: Republican Senator Lindsey Graham, he said, quote, imperative Congress get to the bottom of recent media reports.
sentences.zh: 共和党参议员林赛·格雷厄姆表示，引述：“国会必须彻查最近的媒体报道，这是当务之急。”

sentences.en: Where is President Trump?
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统在哪里？

sentences.en: His number one job is to protect American soldiers.
sentences.zh: 他的头号工作是保护美国士兵。

sentences.en: There was outrage that if indeed this bounty program had existed, what was the United States government doing about it?
sentences.zh: 人们感到愤怒的是，如果这个赏金计划确实存在，美国政府到底在做什么？

sentences.en: How were they protecting their soldiers, first of all, in Afghanistan?
sentences.zh: 首先，他们是如何在阿富汗保护自己的士兵的？

sentences.en: And what steps were being taken to punish the Russians?
sentences.zh: 采取了哪些步骤来惩罚俄罗斯人？

sentences.en: He should have a plan.
sentences.zh: 他本该有个计划。

sentences.en: What are we doing?
sentences.zh: 我们在干什么？

sentences.en: And above all, go after Putin.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，去对付普京。

sentences.en: Because this is at a time when President Trump has continued to carry out conversations with President Putin.
sentences.zh: 因为正是在这个时候，特朗普总统继续与普京总统保持着对话。

sentences.en: In fact, just a few weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 事实上，就在几周前。

sentences.en: The problem is many of the things that we talk about are about Putin.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，我们讨论的很多事情都与普京有关。

sentences.en: He invited Russia to join the G8 conference in Washington.
sentences.zh: 他邀请俄罗斯加入在华盛顿举行的G8峰会。

sentences.en: And I say, have him in the room.
sentences.zh: 而我的观点是，让他加入。

sentences.en: Have him in the room.
sentences.zh: 让他加入。

sentences.en: Much to the disbelief of European allies and even some of his own Republican supporters here in the United States.
sentences.zh: 这让欧洲盟友，甚至他在美国的一些共和党支持者都感到难以置信。

sentences.en: So we have a G7.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有了G7。

sentences.en: He's not there.
sentences.zh: 他不在那里。

sentences.en: Half of the meeting is devoted to Russia.
sentences.zh: 有一半的会议都是关于俄罗斯的。

sentences.en: And if he was there, it would be much easier to solve.
sentences.zh: 如果他在场，事情就会容易解决得多。

sentences.en: So as this information breaks, it breaks against a backdrop of the president continuing to enjoy, in his view, very warm relations with Vladimir Putin in Moscow.
sentences.zh: 因此，当这个消息传出时，其背景是总统自认为与莫斯科的弗拉基米尔·普京保持着非常亲密的关系。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And how does the White House explain this?
sentences.zh: 白宫对此有何解释？

sentences.en: I mean, not only not responding to this Russian bounty program, but actually growing closer to Russia and to Vladimir Putin after our government had reached this conclusion.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，不仅对俄罗斯的悬赏项目没有反应，而且在我们的政府得出这一结论后，反而与俄罗斯和弗拉基米尔·普京走得更近。

sentences.en: Hello, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: The White House's immediate response is—
sentences.zh: 白宫的直接回应是——

sentences.en: The CIA director, NSA, National Security Advisor,
sentences.zh: 中情局局长、国安局局长、国家安全顾问，

sentences.en: and the chief of staff can all confirm that neither the president nor the vice president were briefed on the alleged Russian bounty intelligence.
sentences.zh: 以及办公厅主任都可以证实，总统和副总统都没有听取过关于所谓俄罗斯悬赏情报的简报。

sentences.en: That President Trump was never briefed on this.
sentences.zh: 也就是说特朗普总统从未听取过这方面的简报。

sentences.en: He never had a briefing from the CIA director, from his national security advisor, from his director of national intelligence.
sentences.zh: 他从未听取过来自中情局局长、国家安全顾问、国家情报总监的简报。

sentences.en: And thus, how could he have made any decision on it?
sentences.zh: 因此，他又怎么可能对此做出任何决定？

sentences.en: There is no consensus within the intelligence community on these allegations.
sentences.zh: 情报界对这些指控尚未达成共识。

sentences.en: And in effect, there are dissenting opinions from some in the intelligence community with regards to the veracity of what's being reported.
sentences.zh: 实际上，情报界内部对于所报道内容的真实性存在不同意见。

sentences.en: The White House press secretary is saying that the reason he wasn't briefed was because there was no consensus among the intelligence agencies on what to brief him about.
sentences.zh: 白宫新闻秘书表示，之所以没有向他通报，是因为情报机构对该向他汇报什么内容没有达成共识。

sentences.en: We need to get to the bottom of these reports.
sentences.zh: 我们需要彻查这些报道。

sentences.en: I'm going to be briefed at the White House tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我明天将在白宫听取简报。

sentences.en: I'm asking that my entire committee be briefed by the intel agencies and—
sentences.zh: 我要求情报机构向我的整个委员会作简报，并且——

sentences.en: Democrats and Republicans both demand briefings from the president's top advisers on what the intelligence report says.
sentences.zh: 民主党和共和党都要求总统的顶级顾问就情报报告的内容提供简报。

sentences.en: But is this another situation where the president either was told and just rejects it— And what the president knew and when he knew it.
sentences.zh: 但这是不是又一种情况：总统要么接到了通知却置之不理——总统知道什么以及何时知道的。

sentences.en: Or his people are too scared to tell him because it contradicts this narrative of Vladimir Putin being his buddy.
sentences.zh: 或者他的人太害怕而不敢告诉他，因为这与弗拉基米尔·普京是他的好哥们这一说法相矛盾。

sentences.en: What his aides knew and when they knew it.
sentences.zh: 他的助手知道什么以及他们何时知道的。

sentences.en: And if the president really wasn't briefed, why wasn't he briefed?
sentences.zh: 如果总统真的没有听到简报，为什么不向他汇报？

sentences.en: Right, because the thinking is that the president knowing and not acting is extremely problematic.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为人们的想法是，总统知情却不采取行动是非常有问题的。

sentences.en: But the president not knowing is problematic as well.
sentences.zh: 但总统不知情同样是个问题。

sentences.en: Because what would it say about an administration if the president was somehow not told this information or did not digest it?
sentences.zh: 因为如果总统不知晓或没有消化这些信息，这说明了什么政府作风？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's no good answer for the White House in this.
sentences.zh: 对白宫来说，这个问题没有完美的答案。

sentences.en: Either the president was told and he doesn't remember.
sentences.zh: 要么是告诉了总统，但他不记得了。

sentences.en: He wasn't told because his aides feared what his reaction might be.
sentences.zh: 没有告诉他，是因为他的助手害怕他的反应会如何。

sentences.en: Or he was told and just dismissed it because he didn't believe the intelligence because it involved negative reporting on Russia.
sentences.zh: 或者告诉了他，但他只是不予理睬，因为他不相信这些涉及对俄负面报道的情报。

sentences.en: You have to remember, this has happened before.
sentences.zh: 你必须记住，这种情况以前发生过。

sentences.en: You think back to the allegations that Russia meddled in the 2016 elections.
sentences.zh: 回想一下关于俄罗斯干预2016年大选的指控。

sentences.en: Just now, President Putin denied having anything to do with the election interference in 2016.
sentences.zh: 就在刚才，普京总统否认与2016年大选干预有任何关系。

sentences.en: And when asked about this at a news conference in Helsinki.
sentences.zh: 当在赫尔辛基的一次新闻发布会上被问及此事时。

sentences.en: Would you now, with the whole world watching, tell President Putin, would you denounce what happened in 2016 and would you warn him to never do it again?
sentences.zh: 在全世界的注视下，你现在会告诉普京总统，你会谴责2016年发生的事情，并警告他永远不要再这样做吗？

sentences.en: President Trump turned to President Putin.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统转向普京总统。

sentences.en: I have President Putin.
sentences.zh: 我有普京总统的话。

sentences.en: He just said it's not Russia.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚说过这不是俄罗斯干的。

sentences.en: I will say this.
sentences.zh: 我要说的是。

sentences.en: I don't see any reason why it would be.
sentences.zh: 我看不出有什么理由会是俄罗斯。

sentences.en: But I said, I believe him over my intelligence agencies.
sentences.zh: 但我说过，比起我的情报机构，我更相信他。

sentences.en: This has a different feel to it, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，这次感觉有些不同。

sentences.en: So often we've seen in the past about some of the president's utterances and judgments and tweets,
sentences.zh: 过去我们经常看到总统的一些言论、判断和推特，

sentences.en: which have kind of fallen into partisan camps and people can say what he really meant or not.
sentences.zh: 这些言论往往落入党派阵营，人们可以争论他到底是什么意思。

sentences.en: This is something different.
sentences.zh: 这次完全不同。

sentences.en: This is about soldiers' lives in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 这关乎阿富汗士兵的生命。

sentences.en: This is about somebody's brother, somebody's husband, somebody's daughter, who are on the front lines in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 这关乎在阿富汗前线的某人的兄弟、某人的丈夫、某人的女儿。

sentences.en: And Trump, as the commander-in-chief, doesn't care enough to take the brief, doesn't care enough to read the intelligence about this, or his aides don't think he will.
sentences.zh: 而作为三军统帅的特朗普，却漠不关心到不愿听取简报，漠不关心到不愿阅读相关情报，或者他的助手认为他不屑于读。

sentences.en: Something as sacrosanct as the American soldier, you know, in harm's way in the battlefields of Afghanistan, the White House doesn't have its back,
sentences.zh: 像美军士兵这样神圣不可侵犯的人，你知道的，身处阿富汗战场的水深火热之中，而白宫却不支持他们，

sentences.en: the president doesn't have their backs, that's something very, very troubling indeed, if true.
sentences.zh: 总统没有支持他们，如果属实，这将是非常非常令人不安的事情。

sentences.en: Thank you, Eric.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，埃里克。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Dr. Fauci, based on what you're seeing now, how many COVID-19 deaths and infections should America expect before this is all over?
sentences.zh: 福奇博士，根据你目前看到的情况，在这一切结束之前，美国应该预料会有多少新冠肺炎死亡人数和感染人数？

sentences.en: I can't make an accurate prediction, but it is going to be very disturbing.
sentences.zh: 我无法做出准确的预测，但这将是非常令人不安的。

sentences.en: I will guarantee you that, because when you have an outbreak...
sentences.zh: 我向你保证，因为当你面临疫情大爆发时……

sentences.en: During his latest appearance before Congress on Tuesday,
sentences.zh: 在周二最新一次出席国会听证会期间，

sentences.en: Dr. Anthony Fauci warned lawmakers that the number of new infections in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 安东尼·福奇博士警告议员们，如果目前的状况持续下去，

sentences.en: could more than double if current conditions persiSt.
sentences.zh: 美国的}< >新感染人数可能会增加一倍以上。

sentences.en: We can't just focus on those areas that are having the surge.
sentences.zh: 我们不能只关注那些疫情激增的地区。

sentences.en: It puts the entire country at risk.
sentences.zh: 这让整个国家都处于危险之中。

sentences.en: We are now having 40-plus thousand new cases a day.
sentences.zh: 我们现在的日增确诊病例已经超过4万例。

sentences.en: I would not be surprised if we go up to 100,000 a day if this does not turn around.
sentences.zh: 如果这种局面没有好转，我不排除单日新增病例飙升至10万例的可能。

sentences.en: And so I am very concerned.
sentences.zh: 所以我非常担忧。

sentences.en: His warning comes as a surge of infections in the South and West now extend to the Midwest, where six states are recording higher infection rates.
sentences.zh: 他的这一警告发出之际，南部和西部的感染激增现已蔓延至中西部，有六个州正在记录更高的感染率。

sentences.en: Overall, U.S.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，美国的

sentences.en: infections have increased 80% over the past two weeks.
sentences.zh: 感染病例在过去两周内增加了80%。

sentences.en: And in a closely watched Senate primary in Kentucky,
sentences.zh: 在备受瞩目的肯塔基州参议院初选中，

sentences.en: Amy McGrath, the moderate choice of a Democratic Party establishment, has narrowly defeated Charles Booker, a liberal challenger who harnessed growing public anger
sentences.zh: 民主党建制派的温和派人选埃米·麦格拉斯险胜查尔斯·布克，后者是一位利用了公众对警察暴力的愤怒不断高涨的自由派挑战者

sentences.en: over police brutality.
sentences.zh: 。关于警察暴力。

sentences.en: McGrath will now face Republican Senator Mitch McConnell in the fall.
sentences.zh: 麦格拉斯将在秋季对阵共和党参议员米奇·麦康奈尔。

sentences.en: In its final weeks, the Kentucky primary had become a referendum on the future of the Democratic Party
sentences.zh: 在最后几周，肯塔基州的初选已经演变成对民主党未来的全民公决，

sentences.en: and whether the outcry over race and policing could influence the outcome of an election.
sentences.zh: 即对种族和警务的强烈抗议能否影响选举结果。

sentences.en: Despite losing, Booker won nearly 43% of the vote.
sentences.zh: 尽管落败，布克仍赢得了近43%的选票。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个被严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了许多自称是改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时又令人兴奋的权力争夺战中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《都市》最新一期节目中，我和萨拉·科尼格将带您了解那些试图维持影响力却最终失控的人的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
